note: NOMAD does not index formation energies or hull distances in its search API. Thermodynamic values for the NOMAD-hosted Alexandria PBE calculations were therefore read from the Alexandria OPTIMADE endpoint (raw/nomad_alexandria.json); MP and OQMD mirrors duplicate those databases and are not double counted.
